title: I feel like mall world is a fad
content: I dreamt about mall world since I was young and that’s why I searched it up and it lead me hear bc I couldn’t explain to ppl in real life bc they didn’t understand and I’m glad to be here but I feel like ppl are making up stuff about mall world and I don’t like it bc it’s a real place and I see ppl posting bullshit and tryna be apart of something they are not part of . I can tell if u been to mall world or not iam Native American and I had dreams about stuff that happens in real life since I was 7.
